references.text: Jesus's answer to the demand that he say it 'openly' (parrēsia) is that he has already spoken it, but they do not believe because they are not of his sheep.
Jesus's question 'Who are you?' and the ensuing discussion about his identity as 'I am' (egō eimi) parallel the question of whether he is the Messiah.
The same leaders (the Jews) gather in council to decide whether they should kill Jesus, just as they surround him here to demand an answer before acting.
The people ask a similar question about the identity and duration of the Messiah, showing confusion over Jesus's claims to be the exalted one.
